mapper.select: select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.PERIODSOFONEYEAR,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,count(*) as JOINNUMBER, USERNUMBERS-count(*) as REMANDNUMBER,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD,MAXSCORE,MINSCORE from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME like concat(concat('%',#{vagueName}),'%') and GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME and GAMEGROUP.TEACHERID=#{adminID} and GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID is not NULL group by GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD having USERNUMBERS-count(*)>=0
